story.title: The Ghost Note
story.logline: A pianist discovers the melody she plays every night is actually a warning from her future self.
story.twist: She is not playing to remember the past, but trying to prevent the fire that traps her tonight.
story.ending: Will you listen when the song plays again?

scenes.narration: My fingers never bleed, yet every single night this piano demands the exact same price in pure terror.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 20-year-old woman with messy dark hair and a faded oversized hoodie, playing an old upright piano in a dimly lit wooden room.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on her trembling fingers pressing the ivory keys.

scenes.narration: The score on the music stand is entirely blank, but I hear every haunting note echo through the dark.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 20-year-old with messy dark hair and oversized hoodie, staring at completely blank sheet music on the wooden piano.
scenes.camera: Medium shot over her shoulder facing the blank paper.

scenes.narration: Smoke curls lazily from the floorboards beneath the bench, smelling faintly of old ash and burning copper.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 20-year-old with messy dark hair and oversized hoodie, looking down in panic as gray smoke seeps from the floorboards.
scenes.camera: Low angle tracking shot looking up at her terrified face.

scenes.narration: I tried to stop playing once, but the room instantly grew so cold my breath turned to frost.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 20-year-old with messy dark hair and oversized hoodie, shivering violently as a visible cloud of frost leaves her mouth.
scenes.camera: Close-up on her face, shallow depth of field.

scenes.narration: The melody is a countdown, forcing my hands to move faster as the heat rises around the room.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 20-year-old with messy dark hair and oversized hoodie, playing frantically as orange light flickers on the walls.
scenes.camera: Rapid whip pan from her hands to the glowing walls.

scenes.narration: Every key I strike hammers a nail into a door that has already been locked from the outside.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 20-year-old with messy dark hair and oversized hoodie, slamming her hands down on the keys with tears in her eyes.
scenes.camera: Dutch angle medium shot showing flames in the background.

scenes.narration: I finally recognize the haunting rhythm. It is not music at all. It is my own dying heartbeat.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 20-year-old with messy dark hair and oversized hoodie, clutching her chest with one hand while the other hits a final chord.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on her tear-filled, wide eye reflecting fire.

scenes.narration: The front door bursts into flames outside, proving the warning I refused to believe until it was too late.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 20-year-old with messy dark hair and oversized hoodie, turning her head toward a doorway consumed by roaring yellow fire.
scenes.camera: Wide shot framing her small figure against the giant wall of fire.

scenes.narration: As the roof collapses, my fingers hit the final note, sealing the loop for tomorrow night's performance.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 20-year-old with messy dark hair and oversized hoodie, disappearing into thick black smoke as the piano burns.
scenes.camera: Overhead bird's eye view pulling slowly upward.

scenes.narration: Now the room is silent again. My fingers hover over the ivory keys, waiting for the very first note.
scenes.visual_prompt: Maya, 20-year-old with messy dark hair and oversized hoodie, sitting unharmed at the pristine piano in the quiet, unburned room.
scenes.camera: Static medium shot identical to the very first frame.

caption.hook: Every night, she plays the same fire.
caption.title: The Ghost Note
caption.caption: She thought the phantom melody was just muscle memory, a haunting reminder of what she used to be. But as the smoke begins to curl beneath the door, she realizes every misplaced note was a desperate countdown. How do you stop a tragedy when you're already caught in the flame?
